release_environment.features: profiling compiled; active diagnostics off for ordinary timing

metadata.policy: All serial. Lifecycle 7 triplets, single CLI 20 triplets, fixed workloads 6 triplets (all version permutations), coarse phases 3 rotated triplets. After diagnostic overhead modes 0/1/2/3 x3, pilot/before overhead collected separately. FP ordinary/perf pairs for lifecycle and each fixed medium/long workload, 3 repetitions, all versions. perf cycles:u 499 Hz with frame pointers; symbols processed after timed runs. Lifecycle phases measure fresh Runtime+Context in a warmed process, not cold startup.

regression_probe.aborted_initial_attempt: regression-probe/: one successful child before the collector rejected perf software-event :u suffixes; retained but not pooled with the complete six-pair follow-up

policy.v8_screen: All eight isolated upstream suites, all three versions, one run each, 90-second timeout.
policy.v8_repeat: Every case with three valid first-round results gets two more runs per version. Timeout/failed/incomplete cases remain visible with their exact first-round result and have no performance ratio.
policy.microbench: All five default prefixes, all three versions, three runs each, 90-second timeout.
policy.reason: Separate feasibility from score comparison. Do not turn a censored timeout into a numeric result. The repeat policy is fixed before the screening run.

source.adaptation: identical prefix disables optional performance/os clocks on both engines; original body bytes unchanged
source.timer: verified Date.now fallback on every run (millisecond clock, rounded to next tick)
source.metric: upstream minimum ns/op; lower is better; not a distribution of individual operations
